answer: I made two changes. First, QB25 does not exist on garnet, which has only QB1 to QB20, so I used QB2. QB1 and QB2 share a cz coupler. Second, cx is not a native IQM operation. Native gates are prx, cz and measure. I replaced cx with a Hadamard-style prx(pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB1 and on QB2, then cz on [QB2, QB1], then prx(-pi/2, phase pi/2) on QB2. That sequence acts as H on QB1 followed by CNOT from QB1 to QB2. Both qubits are measured with key m. The fixed circuit is in bell_fixed.json in the worktree. I ran it on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The job completed and returned 00: 54 and 11: 46. Only correlated outcomes appeared, so it is a Bell pair. The mock job cost 0 credits.
